item.title: Plague killed entire families thousands of years before the Black Death
item.description: Ancient DNA shows plague was already killing hunter-gatherers in Siberia 5,500 years ago, long before cities and flea-driven epidemics.

item.title: NSF launches $20M pilot to speed commercialization of deep technologies
item.description: The U.S. National Science Foundation announced a $20 million investment to launch a two-year pilot supporting small businesses in commercializing deep technologies.
